summary: Reviewed 17 units. Issues: 11 error, 46 minor; no regrouping suggested. Main findings: anuyoga unified as 'instruction' (units 4, 7); anarthya = worthless (निरर्थक) in 3 and 14, arthya = petitioners in 10 kept as doubtful; 'hi' dropped in unit 3 restored; pare in unit 15 is loc. sg., not pl.; unit 13 veṣya is more likely dveṣya than veśya (flag suggestion corrected, both conjectural); typo forms in w (anātmavā, avisaṃvādādd, pṛṣṭhas) replaced by corrected forms; final-consonant sandhi in many w forms restored to dictionary form. Only 6 text_flags exist (units 3, 5, 6, 10, 13, 16), not 7; all are plausible typos (10 balavat and 16 rājā- only 'possible'). Not patchable: unit 10 avakṣiptān (accusative in an instrumental series) may need a text_flag; unit 13 conjecture needs a person.
